segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ קָרְאוּ אֶת הַמְּגִילָּה בַּאֲדָר הָרִאשׁוֹן וְנִתְעַבְּרָה הַשָּׁנָה — קוֹרִין אוֹתָהּ בַּאֲדָר שֵׁנִי. אֵין בֵּין אֲדָר הָרִאשׁוֹן לַאֲדָר הַשֵּׁנִי אֶלָּא קְרִיאַת הַמְּגִילָּה וּמַתָּנוֹת לָאֶבְיוֹנִים.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» If the people «read the Megilla during the first Adar and» subsequently «the year was» then «intercalated» by the court and now the following month will be the second Adar, «one reads» the Megilla again «during the second Adar.» The Sages formulated a principle: «The difference between the first Adar and the second Adar» with regard to the mitzvot that are performed during those months «is only» that «the reading of the Megilla and» distributing «gifts to the poor» are performed in the second Adar and not in the first Adar.

moves.summary: the mishna rules on reading in Adar II and states the differences between the two Adars

positions.claim: if the year is intercalated after reading in Adar I, the Megilla is read again in Adar II; the only differences are Megilla reading and gifts to the poor
